summary: Retest of FishCast V1 fixes — ALL THREE FIXES VERIFIED. (1) Swell now appears in contributors for coastal locations: GET /api/forecast?lat=37.7&lon=-122.5 returns today_score.contributors with an entry {key:'swell', label:'Swell', delta:2, note:'Fishable swell'}; Treasure Island (27.7692,-82.769) also exposes swell contributor — confirmed via pytest assertion.
